claims.text: Each of the 5 competency agents must configure retrieval guardrails so the agent uses a well-defined set of content sources and has clear instructions for what it can and cannot answer.
A well-established agent library serves as the organization's automation hub: a central repository where proven agents are cataloged, documented, and made accessible across teams.
Planning begins with a review of the organization's use case repository and facilitated discovery workshops that surface pain points, inefficiencies, and opportunities.
An Effort/Impact matrix helps teams rank candidate agents by business value and implementation complexity so resources go to the highest-return agents.

For each priority agent, assign a project lead and supporting experts, document the current process including baseline performance numbers, design the future-state process with expected improvements, and build an implementation plan covering scope, key dates, success measures, and security and data compliance checks.
Infrastructure preparation is the first build block: configure data source connectors and establish indexing protocols for any new data sources the agent will access.
Measurement insights feed directly back into planning to create a continuous improvement cycle, and successful agents become templates for future development.
SOL-203 designs industry-specific agents that map to common workflows, data sources, and governance requirements.
IND-201 is a factory-style module for turning vertical workflows into reusable agent accelerators.
